provisional_note: Written early, within the first 20 minutes, before the mutation drills. Overwritten as evidence lands. Verdict, score and the mutant table are NOT final in this revision.

tests_pass.notes: PARTIAL: the literal AC4 gate command returns rc=1 in this sandbox (26 cases, 2 failures: keep-going and caller-poison). Both failures are traced to sandbox restrictions (sysctl denied; BSD mktemp -t denied in the per-user temp dir), NOT to the M1b code: the same keep-going failures reproduce on origin/main's rig_check.sh, and with a sysctl probe on PATH all 7 new M1b cases and all 18 original cases are green (see gates).

acceptance_criteria.notes: AC4/AC5/AC13 checked so far: AC13 = 0 held files, 0 .py. AC2/AC3/AC7-AC11 are controller-only (1f baseline runs are explicitly not part of this delivery).

non_blocking_findings.defect: The new M1b control cases run the real tools/suite_profile.sh, which reads the host load through sysctl (or /proc/loadavg) and dies without it. The control therefore is not hermetic w.r.t. sysctl, unlike the M1a control tools/test_suite_profile.sh, which installs a deterministic sysctl probe precisely to 'keep sysctl sandbox restrictions out of fixtures' (tools/test_suite_profile.sh:14-21).
non_blocking_findings.failing_scenario: On any host where sysctl is denied (this evaluation sandbox: 'sysctl: sysctl fmt -1 1024 1: Operation not permitted'), the profiled cases fail for reasons unrelated to the code under test: profile-on, profile-trace, profile-red, golden-keeps-profile go red, and long-success, success-refused, golden-setup, full-no-setup, test-hang fail as they now route through the profiler.
non_blocking_findings.proposed_fix: Add a deterministic sysctl probe to the M1b control's stub bin (as test_suite_profile.sh does) and put it on the gmake-missing PATH as well, so the profiler never reads the host load.
non_blocking_findings.status: candidate; final severity pending the rest of the evaluation
